scenes.line: Meet ICMBOT, your tournament poker coach.
Four left, three paid, and the chip leader shoves. Call or fold? The coach folds. On the bubble, chips are not money.
Choose your opponents: tight, loose, aggressive or passive.
Before every decision, the coach tells you what to do and why, with ICM pressure, stack size and pot odds in one panel.
After each hand, review it and track your overall performance.
Outlast eight bots and take the title. Practice, improve, win. Start training free at icmbot dot one.
